acceptance: benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py (both README instructions and console Next steps) directs contributors to open PRs against develop instead of published-results, with updated unit tests and a changelog.d/ fragment.
results-data/README.md directs contributors to develop instead of published-results.
Released in the next core BenchBox release before Step 5 freezes published-results.
context: Step 3 of the owner-approved Option 1 corpus consolidation plan (2026-11-24). Must ship in a core release before Step 5 freezes published-results so released CLI users are not sent to a frozen branch.
description:
## Problem
The released CLI in `benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py` (lines 107 and 619) prints `PR target: published-results` and instructs contributors to open PRs against `published-results`. Core `results-data/README.md` also directs submissions to `published-results`.

## Change (Step 3 of 6)
1. Update `benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py` and its tests to target `develop` (with a `changelog.d/` fragment).
2. Update core `results-data/README.md` to document the `develop` submission flow.
3. Ship in the next core release before Step 5 retires mirror workflows and freezes `published-results`.
